Overview

Wichita is a city in KS with a population of 397,532. Air Capital of the World with aviation history, affordable housing, and Midwest friendliness. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6b growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables.
